title: Topical index: Nave's Topical Bible and Torrey's New Topical Textbook
rightsNote: Nave (1896) and Torrey (1897) are public domain. The structured JSONL build is from j86schroeder/topical-bible-search (pipeline MIT; errata tracked upstream).
citation: Nave, Orville J. Nave's Topical Bible (1896); Torrey, R. A. The New Topical Textbook (1897). Public domain.
limitations: Nineteenth-century Protestant topical indexes: headings reflect their compilers' theology and vocabulary; coverage is KJV-centric; no African or extra-biblical sources. A starting point for finding passages, not an authority on what a topic means.
